symptom: `mxcli graph-report --exclude OIDC` still lists OIDC in the module coupling section, as a coupling source and target; with --include-framework, --exclude was ignored in every section
cause: The coupling query was the one section built without the module filter, and the filter helper returned "" whenever framework modules were included, dropping --exclude with them
file: `cmd/mxcli/cmd_graph_report.go` (`graphReportSections`: one WHERE builder over framework + --exclude, applied to both ends of a coupling edge)
insight: A per-section filter written inline per query drifts: five sections had it, the sixth (two module columns, not one) did not. Building the section list in a function made it testable against an in-memory catalog with three refs rows; deleting the coupling filter makes the test list OIDC on both ends, which is the reported symptom
